parameters.description: Queue to open.

parameters.description: Specifies how the application accesses the queue, whether to peek, send, or receive. This setting cannot be changed while the queue is open. Access can be set to one of the following values: MQ_PEEK_ACCESS: Messages can only be looked at. They cannot be removed from the queue. MQ_SEND_ACCESS: Messages can only be sent to the queue. MQ_RECEIVE_ACCESS: Messages can be retrieved from the queue or peeked at. For information on limiting who can retrieve messages from the queue, see the description of the ShareMode parameter.
parameters.name: Access

parameters.description: : Messages can only be looked at. They cannot be removed from the queue.
parameters.name: MQ_PEEK_ACCESS

parameters.description: : Messages can only be sent to the queue.
parameters.name: MQ_SEND_ACCESS

parameters.description: : Messages can be retrieved from the queue or peeked at. For information on limiting who can retrieve messages from the queue, see the description of the ShareMode parameter.
parameters.name: MQ_RECEIVE_ACCESS

parameters.description: Specifies who can access the queue. ShareMode can be set to one of the following: MQ_DENY_NONE: Default. The queue is available to everyone. This setting must be used if Access is set to MQ_PEEK_ACCESS or MQ_SEND_ACCESS. MQ_DENY_RECEIVE_SHARE: Limits those who can retrieve messages from the queue to this process. If the queue is opened for retrieving messages by another process, this call fails and returns MQ_ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION. Applicable only when Access is set to MQ_RECEIVE_ACCESS.
parameters.name: ShareMode

parameters.description: : Default. The queue is available to everyone. This setting must be used if Access is set to MQ_PEEK_ACCESS or MQ_SEND_ACCESS.
parameters.name: MQ_DENY_NONE

parameters.description: : Limits those who can retrieve messages from the queue to this process. If the queue is opened for retrieving messages by another process, this call fails and returns MQ_ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION. Applicable only when Access is set to MQ_RECEIVE_ACCESS.
parameters.name: MQ_DENY_RECEIVE_SHARE
